name: Fody Foods Garlic-Infused Extra Virgin Olive Oil (True Garlic Aroma)
whyItWorks: A scientific breakthrough for allium-sensitive IBD patients! Garlic fructans are water-soluble carbohydrates that cannot dissolve in oil. Oil infused with whole garlic cloves captures 100% of the delicious garlic aroma without a single molecule of fermentable fructans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: The safest way on earth to cook with authentic garlic flavor in Crohn's and Colitis. Use for sautéing chicken, drizzling on potatoes, or pasta.
watchOuts: 100% low-FODMAP and fructan-free certified by Monash University.
